quotes.text: D318997 persistence must update only a login matching username and `httpRealm`; matching origin/username alone can overwrite a different service. But `address-book.mjs` selects before the challenge reveals the realm, so a write-side filter alone can retry the rejected credential. Combine realm-aware writes with selection of the most recently changed matching origin/username login while realm is unknown, and test that `"some other service"` remains unchanged while retry uses the recovered CardDAV credential. `modifyLoginAsync` already manages password-change metadata. [Task 5]
